book_name: 前景大学英语综合教程1（基础版）

chapters.name: Unit 1 对话 词汇

words.ex: I got your message this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上收到了你的消息。
words.en: A message is a piece of information or a request that you send to someone or leave for them when you cannot speak to them directly.

words.ex: He works for an international company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家国际公司工作。
words.en: International means involving or relating to more than one country.

words.tr:
prep. 通过；穿过；
adv. 从头到尾地；彻底；
adj. 直通的；
words.ex: He walked through the door.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过了门。
words.en: Moving in one side and out of the other side of (an opening, channel, or location).

words.ex: He drew a straight line on the paper.
words.ex_cn: 他在纸上画了一条直线。
words.en: A line is a long thin mark which is drawn or painted on a surface.

words.ex: He will repeat the question.
words.ex_cn: 他会重复这个问题。
words.en: To say or write something again, either once or several times.

words.ex: The temperature dropped to zero last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚温度降到了零。
words.en: Zero is the number 0; nothing.

words.tr:
n. 两倍；
v. 加倍；是…的两倍；把…对折；
words.ex: He earned a double of his salary last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月赚了两倍的薪水。
words.en: If something is double, it is twice as much or twice as many. If you double something, you make it twice as much or twice as many.

chapters.name: Unit 1 对话 词组与短语

words.tr: phrase. 代为传话；替人留言
words.ex: Can you take a message for me?
words.ex_cn: 你能帮我捎个话吗？
words.en: To take a message means to agree to pass on a communication from one person to another, especially when the intended recipient is not available.

words.tr: phrase. 为...接通电话；顺利完成
words.ex: I will put you through to the manager.
words.ex_cn: 我将为你接通经理的电话。
words.en: To endure or suffer through a difficult experience.

words.ex: He was busy at the moment.
words.ex_cn: 当时他很忙。
words.en: At the moment is used to indicate that something is happening now.

words.ex: He will call back after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后会回电话。
words.en: To telephone someone again, especially in order to give them some information or because they were not available when you telephoned before.

chapters.name: Unit 1 课文 词汇

words.ex: He gave a sincere apology.
words.ex_cn: 他真诚地道歉了。
words.en: If you say that someone is sincere, you approve of them because they really mean the things they say.

words.ex: The passenger got off the bus at the next stop.
words.ex_cn: 这位旅客在下一站下了车。
words.en: A passenger is a person who is traveling in a vehicle but is not the driver or one of the people who works on it.

words.ex: He wants to study medicine at university.
words.ex_cn: 他想在大学学习医学。
words.en: Medicine is the science or practice of the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of disease.

words.tr: n. 女主人；女房东；女招待；女主持人；
words.ex: The hostess welcomed us with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 女主人微笑着欢迎我们。
words.en: A woman who receives or entertains guests in a social or official capacity; a woman who is in charge of a particular event or place and who welcomes and looks after the people who attend.

words.tr:
v. 承诺；答应；
n. 许诺；希望；成功的征兆（或理由）；
words.ex: He promised to help me with my homework.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮我做作业。
words.en: A promise is a statement that you will definitely do something or that something will definitely happen.

words.ex: He brings his lunch to work every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带午饭去上班。
words.en: To bring something means to carry or convey it to the place where you are or to the place you are talking about.

words.tr:
n. 分钟；一会儿；
adj. 微小的；极小的；
words.ex: I waited for five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 我等了五分钟。
words.en: A minute is a unit of time equal to sixty seconds or a sixtieth of an hour.

words.ex: I forget where I put my keys.
words.ex_cn: 我忘记把钥匙放在哪儿了。
words.en: If you forget something, you fail to remember it.

words.tr:
adv. 后来；稍后；
adj. 后来的；稍后的；晚些的；晚年的；
words.ex: He left the party, and later he called his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他离开了派对，后来给朋友打了电话。
words.en: Later means after the present time or after the time you are talking about.

words.ex: The bell rang at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 铃在早上八点响了。
words.en: A bell is a device that makes a ringing sound and is used to give a signal or to attract attention.

words.tr:
v. 给…打电话；响铃；
n. 环；环形物；铃声；拳击场；
words.ex: I will ring you tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我明天给你打电话。
words.en: A ring is a small circular band, typically of precious metal and often set with one or more gemstones, worn on a finger as an ornament or a token of marriage, engagement, or authority. It can also refer to the act of making a clear resonant or vibrating sound, or to encircle or surround something.

words.tr:
n. 匆忙；
v. 赶快；
words.ex: He left in a hurry without saying goodbye.
words.ex_cn: 他匆忙离开，连再见都没说。
words.en: If you hurry somewhere, you go there quickly. If you hurry to do something, you start doing it quickly or do it more quickly than usual.

words.ex: He refused to eat the broccoli.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝吃西兰花。
words.en: If you refuse to do something, you deliberately do not do it, or you say firmly that you will not do it.

words.tr: adj. 接着的；下列的； prep. 在...之后； v. 跟随；“follow”的现在分词； n. 下列各项；
words.ex: The following day, we went to the park.
words.ex_cn: 接着的那天，我们去了公园。
words.en: Coming after or as a result of something; a group of supporters or admirers.

words.ex: I don't know whether he will come.
words.ex_cn: 我不知道他是否会来。
words.en: You use whether when you are talking about a choice or doubt between two or more alternatives.

words.ex: The child needs attention when he does homework.
words.ex_cn: 孩子做作业时需要被关注。
words.en: Attention is the act of focusing your mind on something and taking notice of it.

words.tr: adj. 锋利的；骤变的；灵敏的；尖刻的；
words.ex: The knife is sharp enough to cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀足够锋利，可以切纸。
words.en: Having a thin edge or a fine point that is capable of cutting or piercing; keen.

words.tr:
n. 裂缝；噼啪声；
v. 破裂；
words.ex: There is a small crack in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一条小裂缝。
words.en: If something hard cracks, or if you crack it, it becomes slightly damaged, with lines appearing on its surface.

words.tr:
n. 手；
v. 交；递；给；
words.ex: He waved his hand to say hello.
words.ex_cn: 他挥挥手打招呼。
words.en: The part of the body at the end of the arm that is used for holding, moving, touching, and feeling things.

words.ex: He read the booklet about the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 他读了那本关于新规则的小册子。
words.en: A booklet is a small, thin book that has a paper cover and that gives you information about something.

chapters.name: Unit 1 课文 词组和短语

words.ex: He takes medicine every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃药。
words.en: To take medicine means to consume a substance, usually in the form of a pill or liquid, that is intended to treat or prevent disease or illness.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

words.ex: I saw a car pass by my house.
words.ex_cn: 我看到一辆车从我家旁边开过。
words.en: To move past or go past something or someone without stopping or without paying attention to them.

words.tr: phrase. 不理会；不注意；对…不予理睬
words.ex: He pay no attention to the noise.
words.ex_cn: 他没有注意那个噪音。
words.en: To deliberately ignore or not take notice of something or someone.

words.tr: phrase. 是否……还是……；不管……还是……（用于引导选择或不确定的情况）
words.ex: I will go to the park whether it is sunny or rainy.
words.ex_cn: 不管天晴还是下雨，我都会去公园。
words.en: Used to introduce alternatives or possibilities, indicating that the statement applies to either case.

words.ex: He gets off the bus at the school.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校下车。
words.en: To leave a place, especially in order to start a journey; to remove something, especially clothing.

chapters.name: Unit 1 阅读练习 词汇

words.ex: He spoke in a polite manner.
words.ex_cn: 他以礼貌的方式说话。
words.en: The way in which something is done or happens.

words.ex: The child behaves well in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在课堂上表现得很好。
words.en: To behave means to act in a particular way, especially in a way that is good or correct.

words.ex: He asked politely for help.
words.ex_cn: 他有礼貌地请求帮助。
words.en: In a way that shows good manners and respect for others.

words.ex: This book is helpful for learning English.
words.ex_cn: 这本书对学习英语有帮助。
words.en: If you describe someone as helpful, you mean that they help you in some way, such as doing part of your job for you or by giving you advice or information.

words.ex: He drank tea instead of coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了茶，而不是咖啡。
words.en: If you do one thing instead of another, you do the first thing and not the second thing, especially as the result of a choice or a change of behaviour.

words.tr:
n. 请求；要求的事；
v. 要求；请求；
words.ex: He made a request for help.
words.ex_cn: 他提出了一个帮助的请求。
words.en: If you request something, you ask for it politely or formally.

words.ex: I receive a letter from my friend every week.
words.ex_cn: 我每周都收到朋友的一封信。
words.en: To get or be given something; to welcome someone officially or socially.

words.tr:
prep. 到…时；直到…为止；
conj. 到…时；直到…为止；
words.ex: He waited until the bus came.
words.ex_cn: 他一直等到公交车来。
words.en: Up to the time of; before (a specified time).

words.ex: He pulled out a handkerchief to wipe his sweat.
words.ex_cn: 他掏出一块手帕擦汗。
words.en: A handkerchief is a small square piece of fabric which you use for blowing your nose.

words.tr:
n. 喷嚏；喷嚏声
v. 打喷嚏
words.ex: He had a cold and let out a loud sneeze.
words.ex_cn: 他感冒了，打了一个响亮的喷嚏。
words.en: To sneeze is to suddenly expel air from the nose and mouth due to irritation in the nasal passages.

chapters.name: Unit 1 阅读练习 词组与短语

words.ex: They laugh at his funny hat.
words.ex_cn: 他们因他的滑稽帽子而发笑。
words.en: To laugh at someone or something means to mock or ridicule them, often in a way that is not kind.

words.tr: 短语. 处于困境中；惹上麻烦
words.ex: He is in trouble for breaking the window.
words.ex_cn: 他因为打碎了窗户而惹上了麻烦。
words.en: To be in a situation where one is likely to suffer adverse consequences or to be in difficulty.

words.ex: He went to the post office to send a letter.
words.ex_cn: 他去邮局寄信。
words.en: A post office is a public department or corporation responsible for mail services, including the acceptance, transmission, and delivery of letters and parcels.

words.tr: phrase. 轮到某人；依次行动或参与
words.ex: We take one's turn to read the book.
words.ex_cn: 我们轮流读这本书。
words.en: To do something when it is one's time or chance to do so, especially in a sequence or according to a system.

words.tr: phrase. 提出请求；发出申请
words.ex: He makes a request for help.
words.ex_cn: 他提出求助请求。
words.en: To formally ask for something, often in a polite or official manner.

words.ex: He sings in public every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都在公共场合唱歌。
words.en: In a way that can be seen or heard by other people; openly.

chapters.name: Unit 2 对话 词汇

words.tr:
n. 头脑；意向；心；智力；
v. 介意；注意；
words.ex: He lost his mind after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后失去了理智。
words.en: Your mind is your ability to think and reason. If you mind something, you are bothered by it or you object to it.

words.ex: I prepare my lunch every morning.
words.ex_cn: 我每天早上准备午餐。
words.en: If you prepare something, you make it ready for something that is going to happen.

words.tr: n. 山；山脉；一大堆；大量；
words.ex: He climbed a tall mountain last summer.
words.ex_cn: 去年夏天，他爬了一座高山。
words.en: A mountain is a very high area of land with steep sides, much higher than a hill.

words.ex: The boy will climb the tree to get the ball.
words.ex_cn: 男孩会爬树去拿球。
words.en: To climb means to go up something, such as a mountain or a ladder, usually with some effort.

words.tr:
v. 检查；核对；
n. 检查；支票；阻止；
words.ex: Please check your homework before class.
words.ex_cn: 请在上课前检查你的作业。
words.en: To examine something in order to determine its accuracy, quality, or condition, or to make sure that something is correct or safe.

words.tr:
n. 报告；报道；
v. 报告；报道；
words.ex: He wrote a report about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 他写了一份关于天气的报告。
words.en: A report is a detailed account or statement about a particular matter, especially in the form of an official document, after thorough investigation or consideration by an appointed person or body.

words.ex: He wears a raincoat when it rains.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时，他穿雨衣。
words.en: A raincoat is a waterproof or water-resistant coat worn to protect the body from rain.

words.ex: The child is hungry and cries for food.
words.ex_cn: 孩子饿了，哭着要吃的。
words.en: Feeling or showing the need for food; having a strong desire or craving.

words.ex: He stopped halfway to rest.
words.ex_cn: 他在半路停下来休息。
words.en: At or to a point midway between two others.

chapters.name: Unit 2 对话 词组与短语

words.tr: phrase. 为某事做准备；为某事做好准备
words.ex: He prepares for the test every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上为考试做准备。
words.en: To make ready or able to deal with a future event or situation by doing something in advance.

words.tr: phrase. 假使；如果；万一；以防
words.ex: Keep a flashlight in case of power outage.
words.ex_cn: 以防停电，准备一个手电筒。
words.en: used to describe what should be done if a particular situation, especially a bad one, occurs

chapters.name: Unit 2 课文 词汇

words.ex: The earthquake shook the houses last night.
words.ex_cn: 昨晚地震震动了房屋。
words.en: An earthquake is a sudden shaking of the ground caused by the passage of seismic waves through Earth's rocks.

words.tr:
n. 冲；匆忙；
v. 冲；赶忙做；
words.ex: There was a rush to buy tickets for the concert.
words.ex_cn: 人们争相购买演唱会的票。
words.en: If you rush somewhere, you go there quickly. A rush is a situation in which you need to go somewhere or do something very quickly.

words.tr:
n. 公寓；
adj. 平坦的；扁平的；(轮胎)瘪了的；平淡无味的；
adv. 直接地；
words.ex: He lives in a small flat in London.
words.ex_cn: 他住在伦敦的一间小公寓里。
words.en: Something that is flat is level and smooth, with no curved, high, or hollow parts.

words.ex: He fills the bottle with water.
words.ex_cn: 他把瓶子装满水。
words.en: To make or become full; to put something into a container or space so that it is completely or almost completely full.

words.tr:
n. 废墟；
v. 破坏；
words.ex: The old temple is now a ruin.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的寺庙现在已成为废墟。
words.en: Ruin means the physical destruction or disintegration of something or the state of disintegrating or being destroyed.

words.ex: He dig a hole in the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他在花园里挖了一个洞。
words.en: To dig means to break up, turn over, or remove earth, sand, etc., using a tool, a machine, or your hands. It can also mean to search for something by moving or looking through something, or to like or enjoy something very much.

words.ex: He felt hopeless after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到毫无希望。
words.en: If you feel hopeless, you feel very unhappy because there seems to be no possibility of a better situation or success.

words.tr:
adj. 死的；
n. 死人；
adv. 完全地；
words.ex: The dead bird lay on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 那只死鸟躺在地上。
words.en: No longer alive; deprived of life.

words.tr:
v. 答复；回答；
n. 答复；回答；
words.ex: He replied to my message quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回复了我的消息。
words.en: To reply means to say or write something as an answer to something that someone has said or written.

words.ex: He will continue walking after the break.
words.ex_cn: 休息后他会继续走路。
words.en: If someone or something continues to do something, they keep doing it and do not stop.

chapters.name: Unit 2 课文 专有名词

words.tr: phrase. 美国（美利坚合众国）
words.ex: The United States of America is a federal republic consisting of 50 states.
words.ex_cn: 美利坚合众国是一个由50个州组成的联邦共和国。
words.en: A country in North America, consisting of 50 states and a federal district.

chapters.name: Unit 2 课文 词组和短语

words.ex: The meeting will take place tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 会议将在明天举行。
words.en: When something takes place, it happens, especially in a controlled or organized way.

words.ex: He has less than five apples.
words.ex_cn: 他不到五个苹果。
words.en: If something is less than a particular amount, it is not as much as that amount.

words.ex: No matter how tired I am, I finish my homework.
words.ex_cn: 无论我多么累，我都会完成作业。
words.en: used to say that something is not important or does not affect the situation

chapters.name: Unit 2 阅读练习 词汇

words.tr:
adj. 一般的；普遍的；总的；大致的；首席的；
n. 将军；
words.ex: He gave a general answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了一个一般的回答。
words.en: A general is a high-ranking officer in the army or air force. In other contexts, general refers to something that is common, usual, or not specific.

words.ex: My dog is my favorite pet.
words.ex_cn: 我的狗是我最喜欢的宠物。
words.en: A pet is an animal that you keep in your home to give you company and pleasure.

words.tr:
adj. 相等的；同等的；
v. 等于；比得上；
words.ex: Two plus two is equal to four.
words.ex_cn: 二加二等于四。
words.en: If two things are equal, or if one thing is equal to another, they are the same in size, number, standard, or value.

words.tr:
v. 共享；分享；
n. 分享；股份；
words.ex: They share their food with friends.
words.ex_cn: 他们与朋友分享食物。
words.en: If you share something with another person, you both have it, use it, or are involved in it. You can also say that two people share something.

words.tr: n. 令人讨厌的或繁重的工作；
words.ex: Washing dishes is a boring chore.
words.ex_cn: 洗碗是一件烦人的琐事。
words.en: A chore is a task or piece of work that is often boring or unpleasant but needs to be done regularly.

words.ex: He made a quick decision to leave.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速做出了离开的决定。
words.en: A decision is a choice that you make about something after thinking about it.

words.ex: The preschooler plays with blocks every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这个学龄前儿童每天早上都玩积木。
words.en: A preschooler is a child who is old enough to go to preschool but has not yet started school.

words.tr:
n. 成人；
adj. 成年的；
words.ex: An adult must pay taxes.
words.ex_cn: 成人必须缴税。
words.en: An adult is a mature, fully developed person. An adult has reached the age when they are legally responsible for their actions.

words.ex: Their marriage lasted for twenty years.
words.ex_cn: 他们的婚姻持续了二十年。
words.en: The legally or formally recognized union of two people as partners in a personal relationship.

chapters.name: Unit 2 阅读练习 词组与短语

words.ex: We think of water as a basic need.
words.ex_cn: 我们认为水是一种基本需求。
words.en: To consider or regard someone or something in a particular way.

words.ex: He can deal with difficult problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能处理困难的问题。
words.en: To deal with something means to take action in order to achieve something or in order to solve a problem.

words.ex: Many people see pollution as a big problem.
words.ex_cn: 许多人认为污染是一个大问题。
words.en: To consider or regard someone or something in a particular way.

words.tr: phrase. 去郊游；去户外活动
words.ex: We go outing every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 我们每周末去郊游。
words.en: To go on a leisure trip or excursion, typically for enjoyment.

words.tr: phrase. 使…保持在一起；维系；使团结
words.ex: This box helps me keep my toys together.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子帮助我把玩具放在一起。
words.en: To maintain the unity or cohesion of a group or items.

chapters.name: Unit 3 对话 词汇

words.ex: The climate in summer is very hot.
words.ex_cn: 夏天的气候非常炎热。
words.en: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

words.ex: The weather is mild today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天气温和。
words.en: Mild is used to describe something that is not extreme, severe, or strong, such as weather, taste, or behavior.

words.tr: adj. 令人愉快的；合意的；宜人的；
words.ex: The weather was pleasant today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很令人愉快。
words.en: Something that is pleasant is enjoyable, attractive, or friendly.

words.tr:
v. 设置；使固定；放置；
n. 一组；一套；
adj. 固定的；位于…的；安排好的；
words.ex: He set the alarm for 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他把闹钟设在早上六点。
words.en: To put something in a specified place or position; to adjust or arrange something; a group of things that belong together or are used together; fixed or established.

words.tr: adv. 毫无疑问地；确定地；当然；
words.ex: He will certainly come to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他毫无疑问会来参加派对。
words.en: Without doubt; definitely.

chapters.name: Unit 3 课文 词汇

words.tr: adj. 巨大的；大量的；辽阔的；
words.ex: The desert is vast and empty.
words.ex_cn: 这片沙漠巨大而空旷。
words.en: If you describe something as vast, you mean that it is very large.

words.ex: The weather varies from day to day.
words.ex_cn: 天气每天都在变化。
words.en: If things vary, they are different from each other in size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: This book is widely used in schools.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在学校里被广泛使用。
words.en: In a way that extends over a large area or range; extensively.

words.ex: This region has many mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这个地区有很多山。
words.en: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

words.tr:
n. 影响（力）；
v. 影响；
words.ex: The teacher had a big influence on her students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们有很大的影响。
words.en: The power to affect, control, or manipulate someone or something.

words.ex: The store sells seasonal fruits like strawberries in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在春天出售草莓等季节性水果。
words.en: Seasonal means relating to or happening during a particular season.

words.ex: The temperature today is very high.
words.ex_cn: 今天的温度很高。
words.en: The degree or intensity of heat present in a substance or object, especially as expressed according to a comparative scale and shown by a thermometer or perceived by touch.

words.ex: There is a big difference between apples and oranges.
words.ex_cn: 苹果和橙子之间有很大的差异。
words.en: A difference is a way in which two or more things are not the same.

words.ex: The city is at a latitude of 40 degrees north.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市位于北纬40度。
words.en: Latitude is the distance of a place north or south of the equator, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The ship's longitude is 45 degrees west.
words.ex_cn: 这艘船的经度是西经45度。
words.en: Longitude is the distance of a place east or west of the Greenwich meridian, measured in degrees.

words.ex: The addition of a new chair made the room more comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 增加一把新椅子让房间更舒适了。
words.en: An addition is something that is added to something else, often to improve it or make it larger.

words.ex: The ground is wet after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是湿的。
words.en: If something is wet, it is covered in water, rain, sweat, tears, or another liquid.

words.tr:
n. 东南；
adj. 位于东南的；向东南的；
words.ex: The storm came from the southeast.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来自东南方向。
words.en: The southeast is the direction which is halfway between south and east.

words.ex: The village is located in a quiet valley.
words.ex_cn: 村庄坐落在一个宁静的山谷中。
words.en: A valley is a low area of land between hills or mountains, typically with a river or stream flowing through it.

words.tr:
n. 东北；
adj. 东北的；
words.ex: The storm came from the northeast.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来自东北方向。
words.en: The northeast is the direction which is halfway between north and east. It is also the area that lies in this direction.

words.tr:
n. 西南；
adj. 位于西南的；
adv. 向西南；
words.ex: The storm came from the southwest.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来自西南方向。
words.en: The southwest is the direction which is halfway between south and west.

words.tr:
adj. 低沉的；低垂的；
adv. 低；低矮；在低处；往下地；
words.ex: He spoke in a low voice to avoid waking the baby.
words.ex_cn: 他用低沉的声音说话，以免吵醒婴儿。
words.en: If something is low, it is close to the ground, the bottom, or the base of something.

words.tr:
n. 高峰；顶峰；
v. 达到高峰；达到最高值；
words.ex: The mountain peak is covered with snow.
words.ex_cn: 这座山的高峰被雪覆盖。
words.en: The highest point or level of something; the pointed top of a mountain.

chapters.name: Unit 3 课文 专有名词

words.tr: phrase. 南岭（中国南方东西走向的重要山脉，分隔长江流域与珠江流域）
words.ex: The nanling mountains are in southern China.
words.ex_cn: 南岭山脉位于中国南方。
words.en: The Nanling Mountains are a significant mountain range located in southern China, known for their unique biodiversity and subtropical climate.

words.tr: phrase. 长江，中国最长的河流，也是世界第三长的河流。
words.ex: The Yangtze River flows through many cities.
words.ex_cn: 长江流经许多城市。
words.en: The Yangtze River is the longest river in Asia and the third-longest in the world, flowing from the glaciers of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau in China to the East China Sea at Shanghai.

words.tr: phrase. 淮河（中国东部的一条河流）
words.ex: The huaihe river flows through eastern China.
words.ex_cn: 淮河流经中国东部。
words.en: The Huaihe River is a major river in China, known for its significant role in the country's geography and history.

chapters.name: Unit 3 课文 词组和短语

words.ex: He likes apples. In addition, he likes oranges.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢苹果。另外，他喜欢橙子。
words.en: You use in addition when you want to mention another item connected with the subject you are discussing.

words.ex: This apple differs from that one in color.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果和那个苹果在颜色上不同。
words.en: to be not the same as something else

words.tr: phrase. 一年到头； 全年
words.ex: She plays tennis all year round.
words.ex_cn: 她全年都打网球。
words.en: If something happens all year round, it happens throughout the year.

chapters.name: Unit 3 阅读练习 词汇

words.ex: The train's destination is Beijing.
words.ex_cn: 这列火车的目的地是北京。
words.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

words.ex: He avoids eating sugar to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他避免吃糖以保持健康。
words.en: If you avoid something, you take action in order to prevent it from happening to you.

words.ex: He lives in a tropical island near the equator.
words.ex_cn: 他住在赤道附近的一个热带岛屿上。
words.en: relating to or situated in or characteristic of the tropics (the region on either side of the equator)

words.ex: The sky is overcast today.
words.ex_cn: 今天天空多云。
words.en: If the sky or the day is overcast, it is covered with cloud; dull and not sunny.

words.ex: It is muggy outside today.
words.ex_cn: 今天外面闷热。
words.en: If you describe the weather as muggy, you mean that it is unpleasantly warm and damp.

words.tr: adj. 沉闷乏味的；忧郁的；凄凉的
words.ex: The weather was dreary and rainy all day.
words.ex_cn: 天气一整天都阴沉沉的，还下着雨。
words.en: If you describe something as dreary, you mean that it is dull, lifeless, or depressing.

chapters.name: Unit 3 阅读练习 专有名词

words.ex: Merchants traveled the silk road to trade goods.
words.ex_cn: 商人沿着丝绸之路贸易商品。
words.en: The Silk Road refers to the ancient network of trade routes that connected the East and West, facilitating the exchange of goods, culture, and ideas.

words.tr: phrase. 春城（指气候宜人、春天般的城市，如中国昆明的别称）
words.ex: Spring City is a small town with many flowers in spring.
words.ex_cn: 春天城是一个春天开满鲜花的小镇。
words.en: A city characterized by its spring-like climate throughout the year, often associated with mild weather and blooming flora.

chapters.name: Unit 4 对话 词汇

words.tr:
adv. 进一步；更远；此外；
adj. 更多的；附加的；
v. 促进；
words.ex: He explained the problem, and then gave further examples.
words.ex_cn: 他解释了这个问题，然后给出了进一步的例子。
words.en: to a greater degree or extent

words.ex: He chooses coffee every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都选择喝咖啡。
words.en: To choose means to select someone or something from a group of possibilities.

words.ex: He works hard to improve his English.
words.ex_cn: 他努力改善自己的英语。
words.en: To make something better, or to become better.

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.ex: My tutor helps me with math homework.
words.ex_cn: 我的导师帮我做数学作业。
words.en: A tutor is someone who gives private lessons to one pupil or a very small group of pupils.

words.ex: The phone is expensive.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机很贵。
words.en: Costing a lot of money; having a high price.

words.tr:
n. 面试；访谈；
v. 面试；接见；
words.ex: He has an interview tomorrow for a new job.
words.ex_cn: 他明天有一场新工作的面试。
words.en: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

words.ex: This shirt is suitable for the party.
words.ex_cn: 这件衬衫适合这场派对。
words.en: Something that is suitable for a particular person or thing is right or acceptable for them.

chapters.name: Unit 4 课文 词汇

words.ex: He has a lifelong love for reading.
words.ex_cn: 他对阅读有着终身的热爱。
words.en: Lasting or continuing through all or much of one's life.

words.ex: He spent his lifetime teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 他一生都在教孩子们。
words.en: The period of time during which an individual is alive.

words.tr: adj. 常见的；普通的；共有的；
words.ex: Colds are a common illness in winter.
words.ex_cn: 感冒在冬天是很常见的疾病。
words.en: Something that is common happens often or is found in many places.

words.tr:
n. 经验；阅历；
v. 经历；体验；
words.ex: He has a lot of experience in teaching English.
words.ex_cn: 他有丰富的英语教学经验。
words.en: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity that you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: To develop means to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.ex: He learned cooking skill from his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他从妈妈那里学到了烹饪技能。
words.en: An ability to do something well, especially because you have learned and practiced it.

words.tr:
n. 挑战；
v. 提出挑战；
words.ex: Climbing that mountain is a big challenge.
words.ex_cn: 爬那座山是一个巨大的挑战。
words.en: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

words.ex: The teacher gave us important information about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师给了我们关于考试的重要信息。
words.en: Information is facts or details about a subject, event, or situation.

words.ex: His attitude toward homework is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对作业的态度非常积极。
words.en: An attitude is a way of thinking or feeling about something, which is often reflected in a person's behavior.

chapters.name: Unit 4 课文 词组和短语

words.ex: He keeps on walking even when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 即使累了，他还是继续走。
words.en: If you keep on doing something, you continue to do it and do not stop.

words.ex: He wakes up early in order to catch the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他早起是为了赶上公交车。
words.en: with the purpose of achieving something

words.ex: He tries to keep up with his classmates.
words.ex_cn: 他努力跟上他的同学。
words.en: To keep up with something means to manage to do or have as much of it as is necessary or desirable, or to move at the same speed as someone or something else.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents from time to time.
words.ex_cn: 他时不时去看望他的祖父母。
words.en: If you do something from time to time, you do it occasionally but not regularly.

words.tr: phrase. 信息时代（指以信息技术和互联网为核心、信息成为最重要资源的时代）
words.ex: We live in the information age.
words.ex_cn: 我们生活在这个信息时代。
words.en: The information age is a period in human history characterized by the shift from traditional industry to an economy based on information computerization.

words.ex: He fell behind in math because he missed classes.
words.ex_cn: 他因为缺课而数学落下了。
words.en: To fail to keep up with others; to lag behind.

words.ex: He is looking for a job in the job market.
words.ex_cn: 他正在就业市场上找工作。
words.en: The job market refers to the supply and demand for jobs, where employers look for employees and employees look for jobs. It is a key component of the economy and can be influenced by various factors including economic conditions, industry growth, and technological advancements.

words.ex: Not only does he play the piano, but also he sings well.
words.ex_cn: 他不仅会弹钢琴，而且唱得也很好。
words.en: Used to emphasize that two things are true, especially when this is surprising or impressive.

chapters.name: Unit 4 阅读练习 词汇

words.ex: He has a habit of waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他有早起的习惯。
words.en: A habit is something that you do often or regularly.

words.ex: He creates beautiful paintings with colors.
words.ex_cn: 他用色彩创造美丽的画作。
words.en: To create means to bring something into existence or to cause something to happen as a result of one's actions.

words.tr: adj. 特定的；明确的；具体的；
words.ex: He gave a specific reason for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个迟到的具体原因。
words.en: If someone is specific, they give a description that is precise and exact.

words.ex: He is my business partner.
words.ex_cn: 他是我的商业合伙人。
words.en: A partner is someone who you are involved with in a particular activity, especially in business or in a personal relationship.

words.tr:
n. 目标；对象；
v. 以…为目标；
words.ex: His target is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A target is something at which someone is aiming a weapon or other object.

words.ex: His pronunciation of English words is very clear.
words.ex_cn: 他英语单词的发音非常清晰。
words.en: The way in which a word or a language is spoken.

words.ex: The customer bought a new phone.
words.ex_cn: 这位客户买了一部新手机。
words.en: A customer is someone who buys goods or services from a shop or business.

chapters.name: Unit 4 阅读练习 词组和短语

words.ex: I keep track of my expenses every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天记录我的开支。
words.en: To keep track of something means to stay informed about it or to record it, especially in order to notice any changes or developments.

chapters.name: Unit 6 对话 词汇

words.ex: I like to browse the internet for fun.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢上网浏览消遣。
words.en: To look through or glance at reading matter casually or randomly.

words.ex: He visits the website every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天访问这个网站。
words.en: A website is a set of related web pages located under a single domain name, typically produced by a single person or organization.

words.ex: My teacher gave me good advice about studying.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师给了我关于学习的好建议。
words.en: If you give someone advice, you tell them what you think they should do in a particular situation.

words.tr:
n. 座位；
v. 使坐下；
words.ex: Please take your seat before the class starts.
words.ex_cn: 上课前请坐好你的座位。
words.en: A seat is an object that you can sit on, for example a chair.

words.ex: She is fond of chocolate.
words.ex_cn: 她喜欢巧克力。
words.en: If you are fond of someone or something, you feel affection for them or like them very much.

words.tr: adj. 实用的；实际的；实践的；
words.ex: This tool is practical for everyday use.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具日常使用很实用。
words.en: relating to what is real rather than to what is possible or imagined; likely to succeed or be effective in real circumstances; involving or concerned with experience or actual use; not theoretical

words.ex: He bought a new device to take photos.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一个新设备来拍照。
words.en: A device is an object or machine that has been invented for a particular purpose.

words.tr:
n. 功能；职责；
v. 起作用；
words.ex: The function of this button is to turn on the light.
words.ex_cn: 这个按钮的功能是打开灯。
words.en: A function is the purpose that something is designed to have or the job that someone is employed to do. It can also refer to a mathematical relationship or a social event.

words.ex: He made a choice to study hard.
words.ex_cn: 他选择努力学习。
words.en: If you have a choice, you can choose between two or more things.

chapters.name: Unit 6 对话 词组与短语

words.ex: I have a look at the book.
words.ex_cn: 我看了看这本书。
words.en: To take a brief look at something.

words.ex: Please take a seat and wait for the teacher.
words.ex_cn: 请坐下等老师。
words.en: To sit down in a chair or other place where one can sit.

words.ex: He uses a smartphone to call his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他用智能手机给朋友打电话。
words.en: A smartphone is a mobile phone that can perform many of the functions of a computer, typically having a touchscreen interface, internet access, and an operating system capable of running downloaded applications.

words.tr: phrase. 想到；想起；有...的看法
words.ex: I think of my mom when I eat cookies.
words.ex_cn: 当我吃饼干时，我想起我的妈妈。
words.en: To have a particular idea or opinion about something or someone; to consider something or someone in a particular way.

words.ex: He is fond of playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢踢足球。
words.en: To have a liking or affection for someone or something.

words.ex: I want to find out why he is late.
words.ex_cn: 我想弄清楚他为什么迟到。
words.en: To discover a fact or piece of information, often by making an effort to do so.

words.ex: He will choose from the options on the list.
words.ex_cn: 他将从列表中的选项中选择。
words.en: To select from a range of options or possibilities.

chapters.name: Unit 6 课文 词汇

words.ex: Rain can affect the crop growth.
words.ex_cn: 雨水会影响作物生长。
words.en: To have an influence on or cause a change in someone or something.

words.ex: The school will equip the lab with new computers.
words.ex_cn: 学校将为实验室配备新电脑。
words.en: To provide someone or something with the necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: Nowadays, many children use tablets to learn.
words.ex_cn: 现在，许多孩子用平板电脑学习。
words.en: At the present time, in contrast with the past.

words.ex: The scene at the park was peaceful.
words.ex_cn: 公园里的场景很宁静。
words.en: A scene is a part of a play or film in which the action stays in one place for a continuous period of time.

words.ex: This store is convenient for buying groceries.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店买杂货很方便。
words.en: If something is convenient, it is easy to use or do, or it is useful and suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: They communicate well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此沟通得很好。
words.en: To communicate means to share or exchange information, news, or ideas, especially by speaking or writing.

words.ex: He hunts deer in the forest every autumn.
words.ex_cn: 他每年秋天在森林里打猎。
words.en: To hunt means to chase and try to catch or kill animals for food or sport.

words.tr:
n. 专家；行家；
adj. 内行的；老练的；专门的；
words.ex: He is an expert in computer science.
words.ex_cn: 他是计算机科学方面的专家。
words.en: A person who is very knowledgeable about or skillful in a particular area.

words.tr: n. 进入；入口；条目；参与；参赛作品；
words.ex: The entry to the building is locked after 10 PM.
words.ex_cn: 建筑物在晚上10点后进入通道会被锁上。
words.en: An entry is the act of going into a place or the right to go into it. It can also refer to a door, gate, or passage by which you enter a place. Additionally, an entry can be a piece of information recorded in a book, list, or computer, or the act of recording it.

words.ex: Social problems affect many families.
words.ex_cn: 社会问题影响许多家庭。
words.en: Social means relating to society or to the way society is organized.

words.tr: n. 进展；进步；缓慢前进；稳步前进；
words.ex: The project shows slow progress.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目进展缓慢。
words.en: Progress is the process of gradually improving or getting nearer to achieving or completing something.

words.ex: He misses his youth when he played football every day.
words.ex_cn: 他怀念每天踢足球的青春时光。
words.en: The period of your life when you are young, or the state of being young.

words.ex: I send a message to my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我给朋友发送一条消息。
words.en: To cause to go or be taken to a particular destination; dispatch.

words.tr:
n. 激浪；拍岸浪花；
v. 冲浪；（互联网上）冲浪；
words.ex: He bought a new surf for the beach trip.
words.ex_cn: 他为海滩之旅买了一块新的激浪。
words.en: To surf means to ride on the crest of a wave towards the shore, typically on a surfboard. It can also mean to browse the internet.

words.ex: The project involves simple math and writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目包括简单的数学和写作。
words.en: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

words.ex: This house has a modern design.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子具有现代的设计。
words.en: Modern means relating to the present time, for example the present decade or present century.

words.ex: People in society should be kind to each other.
words.ex_cn: 社会中的人们应该彼此友善。
words.en: A society is the people who live in a country or region, their organizations, and their way of life.

words.tr:
v. 导致；引起；
n. 原因；理由；事业；
words.ex: Smoking can cause lung disease.
words.ex_cn: 吸烟会导致肺癌。
words.en: The cause of something is what makes it happen or exist.

words.tr:
n. 麻烦；问题；困难；
v. 费神；
words.ex: He got into trouble for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而惹上了麻烦。
words.en: If you say that someone is in trouble, you mean that they are in a situation that is difficult to deal with and that may cause them problems.

words.tr: adj. 不合时宜的；过早发生的
words.ex: His untimely death shocked everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他突如其来的去世让所有人都感到震惊。
words.en: If you describe an event as untimely, you mean that it happened earlier than it should, or sooner than you expected.

words.ex: He interrupted me while I was speaking.
words.ex_cn: 我在说话时他打断了我。
words.en: To interrupt someone means to stop them from speaking by saying or doing something, or to cause something to stop happening for a period of time.

words.ex: The professor gave a lecture on history.
words.ex_cn: 教授上了一节历史课。
words.en: A lecture is a talk that someone gives in order to teach people about a particular subject, often at a university or college.

words.ex: My generation grew up with smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 我们这一代人是伴随着智能手机长大的。
words.en: A generation is all the people in a group or country who are of a similar age, especially when they are considered as having the same experiences or attitudes.

words.ex: He is an addict who cannot stop smoking.
words.ex_cn: 他是个无法戒烟的瘾君子。
words.en: An addict is someone who is unable to stop taking harmful drugs, or someone who is very interested in something and spends a lot of time doing it.

words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决复杂的数学问题。
words.en: If a person or thing is capable of doing something, they have the ability or potential to do it.

words.tr:
adj. 依靠的；依赖的；
n. 受赡养者；
words.ex: The child is dependent on his parents for food.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子依靠父母提供食物。
words.en: A dependent person or thing is one that needs the support of another person or thing in order to exist or be successful.

chapters.name: Unit 6 课文 词组和短语

words.ex: The school will equip the lab with new computers.
words.ex_cn: 学校将为实验室配备新电脑。
words.en: To provide someone or something with the necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He communicates with his friends every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天和朋友交流。
words.en: To share or exchange information, news, or ideas with someone.

words.ex: They go to the forest to hunt for food.
words.ex_cn: 他们去森林里寻找食物。
words.en: To search for something or someone very carefully and thoroughly.

words.ex: He posts short messages on his microblog every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天在他的微博上发布简短消息。
words.en: A microblog is a type of blog where users post short entries, such as text, images, or video links, often limited in size.

words.tr: phrase. 使参与；使卷入；使陷入；使牵涉其中
words.ex: The teacher involves the students in the math game.
words.ex_cn: 老师让学生们参与数学游戏。
words.en: To include someone or something as part of an activity or situation.

words.ex: He can play the guitar as well as sing.
words.ex_cn: 他既能弹吉他也能唱歌。
words.en: In addition to; and also; equally with.

words.ex: He lives in a room separate from the others.
words.ex_cn: 他住在一个与其他房间分开的房间里。
words.en: To move or be moved apart so as to leave a space between; to stop living together as a couple.

words.ex: He is capable of solving hard math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他能解决困难的数学问题。
words.en: To have the ability, power, or skill to do something.

words.ex: He is dependent on his parents for money.
words.ex_cn: 他靠父母给钱生活。
words.en: rely on something or someone for support or existence

words.ex: He cares about his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他在乎他的朋友们。
words.en: If you care about something, you feel that it is important and are concerned about it.

chapters.name: Unit 6 阅读练习 词汇

words.ex: He has an addiction to video games.
words.ex_cn: 他对电子游戏上瘾了。
words.en: Addiction is the condition of being unable to stop using or doing something as a habit, especially something harmful.

words.tr:
n. 探究；搜索；
v. 搜索；搜寻；
words.ex: The search for truth took many years.
words.ex_cn: 对真理的探究花了多年时间。
words.en: If you search for something or someone, you look carefully for them because you want to find them.

words.tr:
adj. 每天的；每日的；
adv. 每天；每日；
n. 日报；
words.ex: He drinks water daily.
words.ex_cn: 他每天喝水。
words.en: Something that happens or is done daily happens or is done every day.

words.tr: n. 相互作用；相互影响；互动交流；
words.ex: The interaction between the two chemicals causes a reaction.
words.ex_cn: 这两种化学物质之间的相互作用引起反应。
words.en: An interaction is a situation where two or more people or things communicate with or react to each other.

words.ex: His mood changed after he heard the good news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个好消息后，心情变了。
words.en: A mood is a temporary state of mind or feeling.

words.ex: His personality is very friendly and outgoing.
words.ex_cn: 他的个性非常友好和外向。
words.en: The combination of characteristics or qualities that form an individual's distinctive character.

words.ex: They have a good relationship with their neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他们和邻居关系很好。
words.en: A relationship is the way in which two or more people or things are connected, or the state of being connected.

words.ex: The room was in complete disorder.
words.ex_cn: 房间一片混乱。
words.en: A disorder is a state of confusion or untidiness, or a medical problem that affects the mind or body.

words.ex: The talk was meaningless and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这场谈话毫无意义且无聊。
words.en: If something is meaningless, it has no meaning, or seems to have no meaning.

chapters.name: Unit 6 阅读练习 词组和短语

words.ex: He is searching for his keys.
words.ex_cn: 他正在找他的钥匙。
words.en: To look for something carefully and thoroughly.

words.tr: phrase. 社会失序；社会混乱；指社会结构或公共秩序出现严重紊乱的状态
words.ex: The riot caused social disorder in the city.
words.ex_cn: 这次骚乱导致了城市的社会混乱。
words.en: A state of confusion and lack of order in society, often characterized by lawlessness and unrest.

words.ex: He says he likes sports, but in fact, he hates them.
words.ex_cn: 他说他喜欢运动，但事实上，他讨厌它们。
words.en: You use in fact to emphasize that something is true, especially when it contradicts what has just been said or might be expected.

words.ex: He used to play soccer every day.
words.ex_cn: 他过去每天踢足球。
words.en: If something used to be done or used to be the case, it was done regularly in the past or was the case in the past.

words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 离开前请关灯。
words.en: If you turn off a device or machine, you stop it from operating by pressing a button or moving a switch.

chapters.name: Unit 7 对话 词汇

words.tr:
adv. 迅速；
adj. 快的；迅速的；
words.ex: He runs fast.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得很快。
words.en: Moving or capable of moving at high speed.

words.ex: He has a passion for painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画充满激情。
words.en: A very strong feeling of love, hate, anger, enthusiasm, etc.

words.ex: The youngster rode his bike to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个年轻人每天骑自行车去上学。
words.en: A youngster is a young person, especially a child or teenager.

words.ex: The rain persisted all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨持续了一整天。
words.en: If you persist in doing something, you continue to do it even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.ex: His persistence helped him pass the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他的坚持让他通过了考试。
words.en: Persistence is the determination to do something even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.ex: Water is vital for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you say that something is vital, you mean that it is necessary or very important.

chapters.name: Unit 7 对话 词组和短语

words.ex: I just heard about the new park in town.
words.ex_cn: 我刚刚听说了镇上的新公园。
words.en: To become aware of something through being told about it.

words.tr: phrasal verb. 坚持某事；坚守某种信念或原则
words.ex: He holds to his promise.
words.ex_cn: 他坚守自己的承诺。
words.en: To continue to believe in or adhere to an idea, principle, or plan, despite challenges or pressure to change.

words.tr: phrase. 面对，面临（某种情况或问题）
words.ex: He is faced with a difficult decision.
words.ex_cn: 他面临一个艰难的决定。
words.en: To confront or deal with a problem or difficult situation.

words.ex: He didn't win, but after all, he tried his best.
words.ex_cn: 他没有赢，但毕竟他尽了最大努力。
words.en: You use after all when you are saying that something that you thought might not be the case is in fact the case.

chapters.name: Unit 7 课文 词汇

words.ex: The children screamed with joy.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们因喜悦而尖叫。
words.en: Joy is a feeling of great happiness.

words.ex: They went on a long journey by train.
words.ex_cn: 他们乘火车进行了一次长途旅行。
words.en: A journey is the act of traveling from one place to another, especially when this involves a long distance or a lot of time.

words.ex: He decides to go home early.
words.ex_cn: 他决定早点回家。
words.en: If you decide to do something, you choose to do it, usually after you have thought carefully about the other possibilities.

words.tr:
adj. 深的；
adv. 深深地；
n. 深处；
words.ex: The well is deep.
words.ex_cn: 这口井很深。
words.en: Extending far down from the top or surface; of great vertical extent.

words.ex: There is a hole in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一个洞。
words.en: A hole is an opening or hollow space in something solid, or a place in the ground that is deeper than the surface around it.

words.ex: The visitor took photos of the museum.
words.ex_cn: 这位参观者拍了博物馆的照片。
words.en: A visitor is someone who is visiting a person or place.

words.tr: adv. 兴奋地；激动地；兴冲冲地
words.ex: She shouted excitedly when she won the prize.
words.ex_cn: 她赢得奖品时兴奋地喊叫。
words.en: In a way that shows you are very happy and enthusiastic because something good is going to happen.

words.tr:
v. 笑；发笑；
n. 笑；笑声；
words.ex: He laugh when he saw the funny cat.
words.ex_cn: 他看到那只滑稽的猫时笑了。
words.en: To laugh means to make the spontaneous sounds and movements of the face and body that are the instinctive expressions of lively amusement and sometimes also of derision.

words.ex: It is impossible to finish the race in five minutes.
words.ex_cn: 五分钟内完成比赛是不可能的。
words.en: If something is impossible, it cannot be done or cannot happen.

words.ex: There was silence after the bad news.
words.ex_cn: 坏消息传来后，一片沉默。
words.en: The absence of sound; complete quiet.

words.ex: She stored jam in a glass jar.
words.ex_cn: 她把果酱存放在一个玻璃罐里。
words.en: A jar is a glass or clay container with a wide opening at the top and a lid, used especially for storing food.

words.ex: A spider is crawling on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 一只蜘蛛正在墙上爬。
words.en: A spider is a small creature with eight legs and a body divided into two parts, which spins webs to catch insects for food.

words.ex: The bird ate a worm.
words.ex_cn: 鸟吃了一条蚯蚓。
words.en: A worm is a small, long, thin creature with no bones or legs that lives in soil.

words.ex: The insect flew over the grass.
words.ex_cn: 那只昆虫飞过了草地。
words.en: An insect is a small animal that has six legs. Most insects have wings. Ants, flies, butterflies, and beetles are all insects.

words.ex: Please remove the trash from the kitchen.
words.ex_cn: 请把厨房的垃圾去掉。
words.en: To take something or someone away from a place or off a surface.

words.ex: He put the lid on the box.
words.ex_cn: 他把盖子盖在盒子上。
words.en: A lid is a cover for a container, or the movable cover of the eye, known as the eyelid.

words.tr:
n. 内容；含量；
adj. 满足的；
words.ex: The content of the video is very interesting.
words.ex_cn: 这个视频的内容非常有趣。
words.en: Content refers to the things that are held or included in something, or the state of being happy and satisfied.

words.tr: n. 目标；进球得分；球门；
words.ex: His goal is to finish the project on time.
words.ex_cn: 他的目标是按时完成项目。
words.en: A goal is an aim or purpose that a person or a group of people is trying to achieve.

words.ex: He is an ambitious student who wants to become a doctor.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个有雄心的学生，想成为一名医生。
words.en: Having or showing a strong desire and determination to succeed.

words.ex: He asked for the direction to the station.
words.ex_cn: 他问了去车站的方向。
words.en: A direction is the way that you have to travel to get from one place to another, or the way that something is moving or pointing.

chapters.name: Unit 7 课文 词组和短语

words.ex: He decides to do his homework after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他决定晚饭后做作业。
words.en: To make a choice or judgment about something.

words.ex: I need a couple of minutes to finish this.
words.ex_cn: 我需要几分钟来完成这个。
words.en: A couple of is used to refer to a small number of things or people, usually two or a few more than two.

words.ex: I'll stop by your office later.
words.ex_cn: 我稍后会顺便去你办公室拜访。
words.en: To visit someone briefly, often while on the way to another place.

words.tr: phrase. 计划做某事；打算做某事
words.ex: I plan to go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我打算明天去公园。
words.en: To intend or intend to perform a specific action in the future.

words.tr: phrase. 捡起；获得；接人；恢复精神；偶然学到；加速；逮住
words.ex: He picked up the pen from the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他从地上捡起了钢笔。
words.en: If you pick something up, you lift it up from a surface. If you pick someone up, you go to the place where they are and take them away, often in a car. If you pick up a skill or an idea, you acquire it without formal teaching or training. If something picks up, it improves or increases after a period of inactivity or decline.

words.ex: The box is full of toys.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子里装满了玩具。
words.en: To contain or hold as much or as many as possible; to be filled with something.

words.tr: phrase. 把某物展示给某人看
words.ex: He shows his photo to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他把他的照片给朋友看。
words.en: To present or display an object or information to another person.

words.ex: I'm tired; in other words, I need to rest.
words.ex_cn: 我累了；换句话说，我需要休息。
words.en: Used to introduce a different way of saying the same thing, often to make it clearer or more understandable.

words.tr: phrase. 使某人开始做某事；促使某人着手进行某事
words.ex: The teacher set the students to solving math problems.
words.ex_cn: 老师让学生们开始解数学题。
words.en: To cause someone to start doing something.

words.tr: phrase. 要紧；区别对待；有影响；起（重要）作用
words.ex: Volunteering can make a difference in your community.
words.ex_cn: 志愿服务能为你的社区带来改变。
words.en: If something makes a difference, it affects someone or something positively, especially in a noticeable or important way.

words.ex: In the end, he chose to go home.
words.ex_cn: 最后，他选择回家。
words.en: finally, after everything has been considered or done

chapters.name: Unit 7 阅读练习 词汇

words.tr: v. 无法做到；失败；不及格；倒闭；
words.ex: He failed to finish the race.
words.ex_cn: 他没能完成比赛。
words.en: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or do not succeed in doing it.

words.ex: She turned on the lamp to read a book.
words.ex_cn: 她打开灯来读书。
words.en: A lamp is a device that produces light by the flow of electric current, or by burning oil or gas.

words.ex: The darkness made it hard to see the path.
words.ex_cn: 黑暗使我看不清道路。
words.en: The absence of light in a place, making it difficult or impossible to see.

words.ex: He overcame his fear of speaking in public.
words.ex_cn: 他克服了当众演讲的恐惧。
words.en: If you overcome a problem or a feeling, you successfully deal with it and control it.

words.tr: adv. 否则；在其他方面；除此之外；
words.ex: Hurry up, otherwise you'll be late.
words.ex_cn: 快点，否则你会迟到的。
words.en: in circumstances different from those present or considered; or else

words.ex: He hesitates to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 他犹豫着是否要寻求帮助。
words.en: If you hesitate, you pause slightly while you are doing something or just before you do it, usually because you are uncertain, embarrassed, or worried.

words.tr:
v. 达到；抵达；
n. 伸手可及的距离；
words.ex: He reached his goal after years of hard work.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的努力，他达到了自己的目标。
words.en: To reach means to arrive at a place, especially after spending a long time or a lot of effort traveling. It can also mean to stretch out an arm in order to touch or grasp something, or to achieve a goal or a standard.

words.ex: I will arrange a meeting for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我将为明天安排一次会议。
words.en: If you arrange an event or meeting, you make plans for it to happen.

words.ex: You must clean the room properly.
words.ex_cn: 你必须正确地打扫房间。
words.en: If something is done properly, it is done in a correct and satisfactory way.

words.ex: His belief in honesty never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对诚实的信念从未改变。
words.en: A belief is a strong feeling that something is true or exists.

chapters.name: Unit 7 阅读练习 词组和短语

words.ex: He is on his way to school.
words.ex_cn: 他正在去学校的路上。
words.en: If you are on your way to a place, you are traveling towards it and have not yet arrived.

words.ex: Go ahead, the path is clear.
words.ex_cn: 前进吧，路是畅通的。
words.en: To proceed or continue with something without hesitation.

words.ex: She solved the problem in this way.
words.ex_cn: 她这样解决了问题。
words.en: By means of this method or manner.

words.tr: phrase. 只要；长达；和 ... 一样长
words.ex: You can stay out as long as you come home before midnight.
words.ex_cn: 只要你午夜前回家，你就可以在外面待着。
words.en: used to say that one thing is true or will happen only if another thing is true or happens

words.ex: He is talking all the time.
words.ex_cn: 他一直在说话。
words.en: If something happens or is done all the time, it happens or is done continually or repeatedly.

chapters.name: Unit 8 对话 词汇

words.tr:
adj. 难过的；沮丧的；
v. 打乱；使心烦；
words.ex: He felt upset when his dog ran away.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗跑掉时，他感到很难过。
words.en: If you are upset, you are unhappy or disappointed because something unpleasant has happened to you.

words.ex: The crowd cheered when the team scored.
words.ex_cn: 当球队得分时，观众欢呼起来。
words.en: If people cheer, they shout loudly to show their approval or to encourage someone who is doing something such as taking part in a game.

words.tr:
n. 费用；代价；
v. 花费；
words.ex: The cost of the book is ten dollars.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的费用是十美元。
words.en: The amount of money that you need in order to buy, make, or do something.

words.ex: He put the keys in his pocket.
words.ex_cn: 他把钥匙放进了口袋里。
words.en: A pocket is a small bag sewn into or on clothing so that you can carry small objects such as money or keys in it.

chapters.name: Unit 8 对话 词组和短语

words.tr: phrasal verb. 使高兴起来；振作起来
words.ex: He smiled to cheer up his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着让妹妹振作起来。
words.en: If someone cheers up, or if something cheers them up, they start to feel happier.

words.tr: phrase. 忘了吧；别提了；算了（用于表示放弃某事或让对方不要再提某事）
words.ex: Forget it, I will do it myself.
words.ex_cn: 算了吧，我自己做。
words.en: Used to tell someone that something is not important or not worth worrying about.

words.ex: He saves his pocket money to buy a bike.
words.ex_cn: 他把零花钱存起来买一辆自行车。
words.en: Pocket money is a small amount of money given to a child by their parents, typically on a regular basis, for them to spend as they wish.

chapters.name: Unit 8 课文 词汇

words.ex: The children play in the sunshine.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在阳光下玩耍。
words.en: Sunshine is the light and heat that comes from the sun.

words.tr:
prep. 穿过；横过；在…对面；
adv. 横过；穿过；越过；
words.ex: He walked across the street.
words.ex_cn: 他穿过街道。
words.en: From one side to the other of something with clear limits, such as an area of land, a road, or a river.

words.ex: The children play in the yard after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在院子里玩耍。
words.en: A yard is an area of land next to a building, often with grass and plants, or a unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 meters.

words.ex: The boy picked up a stone from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 男孩从地上捡起一块石头。
words.en: A stone is a small piece of rock that is found on the ground.

words.ex: The cruel king punished the innocent people.
words.ex_cn: 残酷的国王惩罚了无辜的人。
words.en: Someone who is cruel deliberately causes pain or distress to others or feels no concern about it.

words.tr:
n. 眼泪；泪水；
v. 撕裂；撕开；
words.ex: A tear fell down her cheek when she heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 当她听到这个消息时，一滴眼泪从脸颊滑落。
words.en: A tear is a drop of clear salty liquid that is produced by the glands in your eyes when you cry or when your eyes are irritated.

words.tr: adj. 拙劣的；贫穷的；缺少的；可怜的；
words.ex: The acting in that movie was poor.
words.ex_cn: 那部电影的表演很拙劣。
words.en: If you describe someone as poor, you mean that they do not have enough money to live on or that they have very little money.

words.ex: She keeps the room clean every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天保持房间干净。
words.en: To continue to have or hold something; to maintain a condition or position.

words.ex: Perhaps it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 或许明天会下雨。
words.en: You use perhaps to express uncertainty, for example, when you do not know that something is definitely true, or when you are mentioning something that may possibly happen in the future in the way you describe.

words.tr:
n. 结束；尽头；目标；末端；
v. 结束；终止；
words.ex: The end of the movie made everyone cry.
words.ex_cn: 电影的结尾让所有人都哭了。
words.en: The end of something such as a period of time, an event, a book, or a film is the last part of it or the point at which it stops.

words.ex: He works hard to earn money.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以赚取收入。
words.en: To earn means to gain something, especially money or respect, through your own efforts or work.

chapters.name: Unit 8 课文 词组和短语

words.tr: phrase. 用完；耗尽；跑出去；到期
words.ex: We run out of milk every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们每星期天都把牛奶喝光了。
words.en: If you run out of something, you have no more of it left.

words.ex: He is in trouble for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而陷入麻烦。
words.en: In a situation that is difficult or dangerous.

words.ex: He walks across the street every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上走过街道。
words.en: To move over or along on foot; traverse.

words.tr: phrase. 把某人留在学校（不让其回家）；放学后留堂
words.ex: The teacher keeps him at school after class.
words.ex_cn: 老师让他放学后留在学校。
words.en: To ensure that someone remains in school, often implying the prevention of leaving or dropping out.

words.tr: phrase. 出现；跟随；进步；（催促）赶快
words.ex: I didn't see him, but he came along later.
words.ex_cn: 我没看到他，但他后来出现了。
words.en: To appear or arrive, often unexpectedly; to make progress or improve.

words.ex: He works at a store to earn money.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店工作赚钱。
words.en: To receive money as payment for work or services performed.

words.ex: He works hard day after day.
words.ex_cn: 他日复一日地努力工作。
words.en: If something happens day after day, it happens every day without changing.

chapters.name: Unit 8 阅读练习 词汇

words.ex: The murder happened last night in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这起谋杀发生在昨晚的公园里。
words.en: Murder is the unlawful premeditated killing of one human being by another.

words.tr: v. 承诺；犯（罪、错）；（公开地）表达意见；
words.ex: He commit to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To commit means to carry out or perpetrate a mistake, crime, or immoral act; or to pledge or bind oneself to a certain course of action.

words.tr: n. 检查员；巡视员；视察员；
words.ex: The inspector checked the building for safety.
words.ex_cn: 检查员检查了建筑物的安全性。
words.en: An inspector is a person whose job is to inspect something.

words.ex: The employer gave her a raise.
words.ex_cn: 雇主给她加了薪。
words.en: An employer is a person or organization that employs people, paying them for their work.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.ex: I suppose he is late because of the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我认为他因为交通堵塞而迟到了。
words.en: If you suppose that something is true, you believe or imagine that it is true, although you may not have any proof.

words.ex: I wait for the bus at station 15.
words.ex_cn: 我在15号车站等公交车。
words.en: A station is a place where trains, buses, or other vehicles regularly stop so that people can get on or off, or where a particular activity or service is based.

words.tr:
n. 注意；通知；
v. 注意；留心；通知；
words.ex: He gave a notice about the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他发布了关于会议的通知。
words.en: If you notice something or someone, you become aware of them.

words.tr: adj. 不平常的；不寻常的；
words.ex: It is unusual to see snow in this city.
words.ex_cn: 在这个城市看到雪是不平常的。
words.en: If something is unusual, it does not happen very often or you do not see it or hear it very often.

chapters.name: Unit 8 阅读练习 词组和短语

words.ex: He is at work right now.
words.ex_cn: 他现在正在工作。
words.en: If someone is at work, they are doing their job or are busy doing a particular activity.

words.ex: He arrives on time every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上都准时到达。
words.en: If something happens on time, it happens at the time that was planned.

words.tr: phrase. 停止运转；出故障；分解；感情失控
words.ex: The machine broke down yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器昨天坏了。
words.en: If a machine or vehicle breaks down, it stops working. If a discussion, relationship, or system breaks down, it fails because of a problem or disagreement.

words.tr: phrase. 拿掉；离开；起飞；脱下；突然成功
words.ex: Please take off your hat before entering.
words.ex_cn: 进入前请把帽子拿掉。
words.en: If an aircraft, bird, or insect takes off, it leaves the ground and begins to fly.

chapters.name: Unit 9 对话 词汇

words.ex: He mainly eats vegetables and fruit.
words.ex_cn: 他主要吃蔬菜和水果。
words.en: You use mainly to indicate that a statement is true in most cases or to a large extent.

words.ex: He can describe the picture in one sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他能用一句话描述这幅画。
words.en: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

words.ex: I appreciate the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 我欣赏大自然的美。
words.en: If you appreciate something, you recognize its value and feel grateful for it.

words.ex: He gave a meaningful speech that helped many people.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一次有意义的演讲，帮助了很多人。
words.en: If you describe something as meaningful, you mean that it is important, serious, or useful in some way.

chapters.name: Unit 9 课文 词汇

words.ex: He is an unmarried man who lives alone.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个独居的未婚男子。
words.en: Not married; single.

words.ex: The company made the adoption of new technology quickly.
words.ex_cn: 公司迅速采用了新技术。
words.en: The act of legally taking another's child and bringing it up as one's own, or the act of accepting something new.

words.tr:
v. 落下；掉下；
n. 滴；下落；
words.ex: The apple dropped from the tree.
words.ex_cn: 苹果从树上落了下来。
words.en: If you drop something, you accidentally let it fall.

words.tr:
v. 回忆起；召回；
n. 记忆力；
words.ex: I recall my first day at school.
words.ex_cn: 我想起了我上学的第一天。
words.en: If you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it.

words.ex: The ancient temple stands on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 这座古老的庙宇矗立在山上。
words.en: A temple is a building used for the worship of a god or gods in some religions.

words.ex: He built a wall with red brick.
words.ex_cn: 他用红砖砌了一堵墙。
words.en: A brick is a rectangular block of baked clay used for building walls, which are usually red or brown.

words.ex: He has faith in his ability to win.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己赢得比赛有信心。
words.en: Strong belief in the doctrines of a religion, based on spiritual conviction rather than proof.

chapters.name: Unit 9 课文 词组和短语

words.tr: phrase. 未婚母亲；未结婚而生育子女的母亲
words.ex: The unmarried mother works hard to raise her child.
words.ex_cn: 这位未婚母亲努力抚养她的孩子。
words.en: A woman who has a child or children but is not married.

words.ex: He is a college graduate who works at a bank.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名大学毕业生，在银行工作。
words.en: A college graduate is someone who has successfully completed a course of study at a college or university and has received a degree.

words.ex: He decided to drop out of the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他决定不参加比赛。
words.en: If someone drops out of a school or a course, they leave it before they have finished it.

chapters.name: Unit 9 阅读练习 词汇

words.ex: His birth was in a small village.
words.ex_cn: 他出生在一个小村庄。
words.en: The emergence of a baby or other young from the body of its mother; the start of life as a physically separate being.

words.ex: His death made everyone very sad.
words.ex_cn: 他的去世让所有人都很难过。
words.en: The end of the life of a person or organism.

words.tr: n. 事件；大事；比赛项目；
words.ex: The school event was fun for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 学校的活动对每个人都很有趣。
words.en: An event is something that happens, especially when it is unusual or important.

words.tr:
n. 记号；分数；痕迹；
v. 做标记；（使）留痕迹；评分；
words.ex: He put a mark on the map to show the place.
words.ex_cn: 他在地图上做了一个记号来表示那个地方。
words.en: A mark is a small area or spot on a surface which is different in colour or texture from the area around it. If you mark something, you make a mark on it in order to identify it or to give information about it.

words.tr:
adj. 特别的；特殊的；
n. 特价；特色菜；专车；特别的物品；
words.ex: This is a special day for me.
words.ex_cn: 这一天对我来说很特别。
words.en: Something that is special is different from normal things, or is considered to be better than normal things.

words.ex: The wedding ceremony was beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼仪式很美丽。
words.en: A ceremony is a formal event held on special occasions such as weddings, graduations, or official functions, often involving traditional or religious rituals.

words.ex: We celebrate my birthday with cake and friends.
words.ex_cn: 我们用蛋糕和朋友庆祝我的生日。
words.en: To celebrate means to mark a special day, event, or occasion with festivities or ceremonies. It can also mean to praise or honor someone or something.

words.tr:
n. 特点；特性；
adj. 典型的；特有的；
words.ex: Honesty is a key characteristic of a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一个好朋友的关键特点。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.ex: He sent her a card with congratulations.
words.ex_cn: 他给她寄了一张写有祝贺的卡片。
words.en: an expression of pleasure at someone's success or good fortune

words.tr:
adj. 目前的；在场的；
n. 目前；礼物；
v. 呈现；提出；
words.ex: The present situation is very difficult.
words.ex_cn: 目前的形势非常困难。
words.en: If you say that someone is present at an event, you mean that they are there.

words.ex: He spoke on behalf of his team.
words.ex_cn: 他代表他的团队发言。
words.en: If you do something on someone's behalf, you do it for that person as their representative.

words.ex: The newborn baby slept quietly in its mother's arms.
words.ex_cn: 新生的婴儿安静地躺在母亲的怀里。
words.en: A newborn baby or animal has recently been born.

words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.ex: The wedding was held in a small church.
words.ex_cn: 婚礼在一座小教堂举行。
words.en: A wedding is a marriage ceremony and the party or special meal that often takes place after the ceremony.

words.ex: He felt sadness after losing his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他失去狗后感到悲伤。
words.en: Sadness is the feeling of being unhappy, especially because something bad has happened.

words.tr:
n. 哀悼；悲痛；服丧
v. 悼念；哀痛；“mourn”的现在分词
words.ex: He is mourning the loss of his dog.
words.ex_cn: 他正在为失去他的狗而哀悼。
words.en: Mourning is the expression of deep sorrow for someone who has died, typically involving following certain conventions such as wearing black clothes.

chapters.name: Unit 9 阅读练习 词组和短语

words.ex: He spoke on behalf of his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他代表他的妹妹发言。
words.en: If you do something on behalf of someone, you do it as their representative or in their interest.

words.tr: phrase. 经历；仔细检查；完成；通过；穿过
words.ex: He went through a hard time last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年经历了一段艰难的时光。
words.en: To experience something, often something difficult or unpleasant, or to examine or discuss something in detail.

words.tr: phrase. 建立；创立；设立；架起；提出
words.ex: He set up a small shop last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年开了一家小商店。
words.en: To set up something means to establish it or arrange it.
